brief:
Israeli attacks on Gaza over the weekend killed at least six Palestinians, including children, according to UN News. The strikes occurred despite a ceasefire agreement that has been in place for a year.

The escalating violence also extends to the West Bank, where Israeli attacks on olive farmers have intensified, creating what UN News characterized as a "season of fear" for Palestinian agricultural workers in the occupied territory.
dek: Israeli attacks on war-torn Gaza over the weekend killed at least six Palestinians, including children, despite a year-old ceasefire agreement.
title: Israeli strikes kill Palestinians in Gaza despite year-old ceasefire
